hero.name: Sepehr Fathi
hero.roleLine: I build software that actually works — from cross-platform Flutter apps to AI and computer-vision systems — and I hold an invention of my own: a nano-bubble water purifier.

about.title: About
about.lead: I'm a software engineer, inventor and founder who ships real, working systems — not demos.
paragraphs: I'm Sepehr Fathi. Since 2021 I've worked professionally on software — cross-platform Flutter apps, PWAs, municipal admin panels and citizen super-apps (Bardaskan and others), plus web and backend. I founded Vira Web Aria and today serve as its chairman of the board.

Today I'm a co-founder of several startups (Shenasnameh Khodro, Masraf, AvaNobat), CEO of Nano Hobab Roshana and the inventor of its nano-bubble water purifier, and a senior engineer for the Norwegian companies Quattro and Nanomarm. Alongside that I build AI and computer-vision systems — an offline Iranian license-plate car-finder, a property-risk platform for Norwegian insurers, and a bioinformatics engine for CAR-T target discovery.

roles.title: Roles & leadership
roles.subtitle: Founding, chairing, leading and building — across product, engineering and R&D.

items.detail: I founded Vira Web Aria — the company behind the Onwebs digital agency (web, apps, design, SEO & marketing) and its product R&D — and chair its board.
CEO of the company commercialising the nano-bubble water-treatment device I invented.
Co-founder of several product startups — a vehicle-identity platform, a consumption-tracking app and an appointment/booking app.
Senior developer building AI-driven and geospatial platforms — including a Norwegian property-risk system — for two technology companies.

ventures.title: Selected work
ventures.subtitle: A few systems that show the range — each real, and shipped.

items.name: PlateYab
items.summary: An on-premise smart car-finder for parking lots that reads Iranian license plates from existing cameras and shows a visitor exactly where their car is — with a photo — in seconds, running entirely on one mini-PC inside the building (a real ALPR kiosk with a LAN admin panel).
points: Multi-frame evidence fusion lifts accuracy from 79.4% (single frame) to a measured 98.3% per car — the core innovation.
99.08% character-classifier accuracy on 8,383 held-out real samples; a segmentation-free CRNN+CTC reader handles the whole plate at once.
Human-in-the-loop active learning fine-tunes the model on-site, from the parking lot's own footage.
Fully offline and localized: Jalali calendar, Persian RTL PDF, argon2/CSRF/RBAC security.

items.name: Aerial Object Detection
items.summary: A YOLOv8-based object-detection model that spots flying objects — birds, airplanes and other aerial objects — in images, recorded video and a live webcam feed, wrapped in a local web app that runs entirely on your own machine.
points: Real-time, multi-class detection of aerial objects (birds, airplanes and more).
Three input modes — single image, video file and live webcam — behind one clean local web interface.
YOLOv8 inference with a lightweight JavaScript front end; nothing leaves the device.

items.name: NanoSWIM
items.summary: A nano-bubble water-treatment technology I invented — chlorine-free water disinfection using nanobubbles — commercialised through Nano Hobab Roshana (Iran) and NanoMAR AS (Norway). Physical deep-tech taken from idea to product.
points: An original nanobubble approach to chlorine-free water disinfection and purification.
Taken from invention to real companies (Nano Hobab Roshana, NanoMAR AS) driving it to market.
Bridges physical hardware R&D with the bilingual product sites and software that support it.

items.name: HomAI · Cuatro
items.summary: A web platform (now V4) that produces insurance-grade roof and property risk reports for Norwegian addresses, blending official registries, live climate-hazard data, LiDAR terrain and multimodal AI vision with a deterministic, auditable scoring engine.
points: The AI perceives and narrates, but explicit code decides — the model never sets a risk score.
Ten weighted risk factors with a transparent formula; the same inputs always produce the same score.
Live Norwegian government data (Kartverket, NVE, MET, NIBIO) plus LiDAR relief for true 3-D roof shape.

items.name: CAR-T Target Discovery
items.summary: A full-stack system that identifies and ranks candidate target antigens for CAR-T cell-therapy design from real NCBI GEO genomic data — a rigorous, hypothesis-generating research tool with an AI interpretation layer.
points: Five-stage pipeline: data acquisition (NCBI GEO) → differential expression → surface-antigen filter (UniProt, GO terms) → scoring → visualization.
Validated by rediscovering clinically-approved targets: CD19 in ALL (rank 1), CD33 & FLT3 in AML, HER2/MUC1/EpCAM in breast cancer.
FastAPI pipeline + a React/Recharts dashboard; the AI layer enforces scientific caution and makes no clinical claim.

items.name: PrismBench
items.summary: A PHP platform to compare, price and resell multi-model AI (LLM) messaging — with a user wallet and payment gateway — turning access to several models into a sellable product.
points: Side-by-side comparison and pricing across multiple AI models.
Built-in wallet and payment gateway for selling AI message credits.
A complete, self-hosted PHP panel — no framework lock-in.

prompt.title: Prompt Engineering
prompt.lead: I engineer language and vision models into production systems where correctness, safety and reproducibility matter — not chatbots, but AI components with strict contracts, tested like any other critical code.

points.title: Strict-schema contracts
points.text: Every model response is JSON-validated and clamped to enums and ranges in code. Stray keys and out-of-range values are discarded before they reach a user — the model proposes, the schema disposes.

points.title: Separation of duties
points.text: The model perceives or narrates; deterministic code decides. In my Norwegian risk platform, AI vision describes the roof, but explicit code sets the score — the model never makes the clinical or financial call.

points.title: Determinism & reproducibility
points.text: Temperature 0 for perception and classification, low temperature for narrative, content-hash caching. Same inputs, same output — a prerequisite for anything auditable.

points.title: Anti-hallucination guards
points.text: Unknown means null and lower confidence, never a fabricated guess. Un-assessed states are shown explicitly, and caution is enforced by the prompt itself.

points.title: Systematic reasoning methods
points.text: Structured prompt methods — quadrant-by-quadrant counting, count-once-across-images, evidence weighting — that make a model measurably, repeatably more reliable on hard real-world inputs.

points.title: On-device AI
points.text: Integrating language and vision models locally, under tight constraints, so intelligent systems keep working where cloud AI can't.

prompt.note: These aren't abstractions — every principle here is load-bearing in a system I've shipped.
